RUNNABLE_JOINT_IMAGING.scope: Measurement-only 19-parameter restricted joint FEM reconstruction with continuous ellipse and full-wave outputs

BLIND_TARGET_ACCURACY.scope: Position/IoU/real-permittivity conjunction; repeated methods/noise are not independent worlds; not general accuracy, loss recovery or population success rate

UNKNOWN_WALL_VALIDITY.scope: All six public macrocell permittivities/losses unknown; exact air allowed; no GT mask. Not arbitrary wall geometry or enclosed cavity topology

FULL_WAVE_PHYSICS.scope: Inherited P3 full TM FEM and RHS derivative; two endpoints refined. No continuous PDE certificate; truth fine-grid changes exceed historical W 0.1 tolerance

FIXED_CHART_MECHANISM.scope: Reference material-forcing chart; dynamic material tangents can escape it. Does not falsify native fixed-vacuum SOM/TSOM

ADAPTIVE_CHART_INCREMENT.scope: Restores quality relative to fixed chart on r0, but no gain over ordinary Full-GN and higher total cost; cache/TR path limitations retained

BASELINE_FAIRNESS.scope: Same public seeds/prior/data and optimization ceilings for three primary methods; full objective selects branches. Conditional controls have fewer active coordinates, oracle extra information disclosed

PAPER_LEVEL_NOVELTY.scope: R3 runnable evidence and failure attribution; standard Schur/resolvent/SVD and A17X inheritance not claimed new. Stronger target-identifiability theory remains a research opportunity

REPRODUCIBILITY.scope: Exact actual state; fresh dependency install NOT_RUN; original campaign cannot silently be restarted
